body: Replanned at the person’s request: draft revision 5 compresses THREE sprints to TWO, preserving all twelve work tickets, both human checkpoints and both actual packaged OS proofs. S1 DM-541–546; S2 DM-547–552. Two independent planning reviews found that missing decisions—not missing prose—blocked junior execution. Every ticket now includes prerequisite/ownership, numbered steps, named tests and Given/Action/Expected cases; acceptance covers every work ticket. Inspected vitest.config.ts and corrected proposed native TypeScript tests to src/integration so targeted commands discover them. Fixed TTL/limits/batch/Stop/privacy/evidence semantics and disclosed that requested desktop tool content may reach a remote model provider. IMPORTANT: conditional junior readiness only. DM-541 must first prove the unresolved human-only boundary and freeze exact schemas/catalog/integrity/host/native handoffs. DM-543/544/548/551 and actual Windows/macOS native verification remain specialist work; detailed text does not make these low-tier tasks. DM-552 is small/routine/low after accepted evidence. Missing mandatory host/OS proof or a human-only bypass blocks acceptance, not a scope reduction. Structural validation: valid, zero errors/warnings; original twelve work ids retained. Draft remains unsaved and no implementation/install/input was performed.
